stem_md: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^{1/4}dy\int_y^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx+\int_{1/4}^{1/2}dy\int_y^{1/2}f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad]
search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^{1/4}dy\int_y^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx+\int_{1/4}^{1/2}dy\int_y^{1/2}f(x,y)dx$ 的积分次序[\quad] $\int_0^{1/2}dx\int_{x^2}^xf(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^{1/4}dx\int_{\sqrt x}^xf(x,y)dy+\int_{1/4}^{1/2}dx\int_{1/4}^xf(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^{1/2}dx\int_0^{\sqrt x}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^{1/4}dx\int_x^{\sqrt x}f(x,y)dy+\int_{1/4}^{1/2}dx\int_x^{1/2}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^{\frac{1}{2}}dx\int_{x^2}^{x}f(x,y)dy$。
